ache.title: Tarot Whispers: ranking your gear into worry
ache.note: Nero ranks Sword of Convallaria’s Tarot Whispers, one of three gear types, from crit boosts to damage reduction, for both PvM and PvP. A gear tier list helps with confusion, but it also hands you a new checklist to complete. With PvP in the mix, “situational” starts to sound like “not good enough.”
watch: one more gear system to complete
PvP making good gear feel bad
ache.tip: Pick gear that works for how you play. Ignore the PvP ladder if it starts to stress you.

videoData.title: Tarot Whispers Tierlist | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: In this video, I dive into the world of Tarot Whispers, one of the three types of gear in Sword of Convallaria, explaining their importance and effects on character stats. I address common questions and confusion about them, and create a tier list to identify the most useful and situational Tarot Whispers. From crit rate boosts with Verdict of Justice to damage reduction with Silence of the Hermit, and many more, I rank and discuss each one, providing detailed insights and considerations for both PvM and PvP scenarios. Join me as we explore and analyze the game's gear to enhance our strategy and gameplay!
